overview_description.description:
Bank AlBilad strives for excellence in the Islamic banking sector through the introduction of initiatives, innovation, and genuine shariah-compliant banking products to meet and transcend the aspirations of the customers, employees, and shareholders. It provides solutions in multiple segments including retail banking, business products, investment, and international remittance.

The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Riyadh.

about_short_description.short_description: Bank AlBilad provides solutions in multiple segments including retail banking, business products, investment, and international remittance.

product.name: Retail Banking
product.description: Sharia-compliant banking services for individual customers, including accounts, payments, cards, financing, and digital banking access.

product.name: Business Banking
product.description: Banking and financing services for businesses, including transaction accounts, cash management, working capital, and business finance.

product.name: Personal Financing
product.description: Sharia-compliant financing for individuals to support personal needs such as purchases, expenses, or other eligible financial requirements.

product.name: Cards and Payment Services
product.description: Payment instruments and related services that enable customers to make purchases, withdraw cash, and conduct electronic transactions.

product.name: Digital Banking
product.description: Online and mobile banking services for managing accounts, transfers, payments, cards, and other banking activities remotely.

product.name: Investment Services
product.description: Investment-related products and services for customers seeking Sharia-compliant opportunities to manage and grow financial assets.
